note: Re-judged 2026-10-26 (independent auditor, authored none of the change). RFC 4271 Section 8.2.2 (Idle), rfc/full/rfc4271.txt: "In response to a ManualStart event (Event 1) or an AutomaticStart event (Event 3), the local system: - initializes all BGP resources for the peer connection, - sets ConnectRetryCounter to zero, - starts the ConnectRetryTimer with the initial value, - initiates a TCP connection to the other BGP peer, - listens for a connection that may be initiated by the remote BGP peer, and - changes its state to Connect." 8ad62e730f changed the producer peer_run.go::runOnce by one argument only: the deferred sessionDown now receives the session's receivePublication, so the close reason is derived after the delivery worker drains (sessionLeave.close, sessionCloseFor in peer_session_end.go). That path decides the close reason, session-dropped, the plugin down and the history row; it does not touch the ConnectRetryCounter, cycleReachedEstablished, newSession or the Event 3 / Event 6 / Event 1 choice. Re-read runOnce at HEAD: newSession creates fresh per-cycle session resources, SetConnectRetryCounter hands the FSM the peer-owned counter before the start event, cycleReachedEstablished.Swap(false) selects AutomaticStart (Event 3) after an Established cycle and the damped Event 6 otherwise, operatorStarted.Swap(true) keeps Event 1 for the first start, and the Established callback stores cycleReachedEstablished true. fsm.go::handleIdle and all five tagged units are unchanged. Re-read the tagged units independently: TestRFC4271AutomaticStartZeroesConnectRetryCounter seeds 7 in Idle and requires exactly 0 plus Connect (Active when passive) after Event 3; TestRFC4271AutomaticStartZeroesOnlyFromIdle requires Event 6 in Idle to keep 7 and Event 3 in every non-Idle state to keep 7 and the state; the live-peer reactor tests require 1 after an Established session ends by Cease or hold expiry and 0 on the next dial (Event 3), and 1 retained when the failed cycle never reached Established, including after an earlier Established cycle (discriminating a stale established flag). Exact-value assertions, isolated inputs, polarities violate this clause and not a neighbour. Ran the five tagged tests against a git archive HEAD export: all pass. Discrimination records are whole-body panic breaks of handleIdle, startAutomatic, startDamped and runOnce: they prove the tests reach those producers, not by themselves the exact clause; the exact-value assertions above carry that. Resource initialisation is observed through real session establishment per cycle, not separately asserted; Section 8.2.1.5 leaves its details implementation-dependent. This row does not certify the timer/TCP/listen/Connect list items beyond the Connect/Active state check, which belong to sibling rows. Verdict unchanged: enforced.
